name: Stonetalon Supply Run
summary: At Stonetalon Peak, Innkeeper Faralia awaits supplies after a courier was killed and the shipment went missing. The Pridewing wyverns may have carried the bundles away.

sections.title: A Lost Shipment
sections.body: A dead courier lies beside a scattered pack, and a note names Innkeeper Faralia at Stonetalon Peak as the intended recipient. You are asked to recover the missing Stonetalon Supplies from the Pridewing Wyverns. Faralia hopes the shipment arrives soon.

sections.title: Faralia's Thanks
sections.body: Faralia learns the courier did not survive. She says she will put the recovered supplies to use, so the courier's loss will not be in vain.

faq.answer: The note identifies Innkeeper Faralia at Stonetalon Peak as the recipient.
The courier was killed, and the body bears marks from many strikes by Pridewing wyverns.
A shipment of supplies meant for Innkeeper Faralia is missing from the courier's discarded pack.
The Pridewing Wyverns may have carried the supply bundles away to line their nests.
Faralia is waiting for the missing shipment of supplies intended for her at Stonetalon Peak.

attribution: In-game quest text: Stonetalon Supply Run
